mismatched_day_null.selection_rule: symmetric fixed day offsets declared before any control MAG result is retrieved
mismatched_day_null.pairing_rule: all admitted ACE/Wind offset combinations except equal offsets

event_class_controls.selection_boundary: class membership must be frozen from an independent catalog or index before MAG gate results are downloaded

interpretation_limits: the detector thresholds and timing radii are identical to the frozen Gannon gate-density contract
circular-shift and mismatched-day fractions are empirical under their declared generators
the hard-null tail fractions are not independent-minute probabilities
mismatched-day controls preserve within-day activity but deliberately destroy physical simultaneity
quiet, moderate, and isolated-event controls remain pending in this version
a hard-null exceedance does not identify one discontinuity or prove propagation
no interpolation or forward fill is allowed
GSE vector rotation is not a GSM clock-angle or geoeffectiveness claim
thresholds must not be retuned after seeing the control results
common-surface, physical-class, and ephemeris claims remain disabled
